issues.event: Advent International commits $1B to defense tech, co-leads Shield AI $1.5B Series G at $12.7B valuation
issues.article_text: A Advent International comprometeu até US$ 1 bilhão em tecnologia de defesa, estreando com a co-liderança da rodada Série G de US$ 1,5 bilhão da Shield AI (sistemas autônomos militares), avaliada em US$ 12,7 bilhões.
issues.detail: Shield AI announced the $1.5B Series G round (co-led by Advent) on March 26, 2026 — three days before the research window opened (March 29 10:00 BRT). Multiple outlets (Fortune, TechCrunch, Bloomberg, Benzinga) covered it on March 26. The Pulse 2.0 article dated March 29 in research.json was a late pickup, not a new event.
